name: @open-deutsch/desktop
description: Electron main, preload, and React renderer entry point for Open Deutsch.
author: Open Deutsch maintainers

scripts.build: tsc -b --force && vite build --config vite.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts
scripts.package:appimage: pnpm --workspace-root exec electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.test: pnpm --workspace-root exec vitest run --config vitest.config.mjs --project desktop
